name: icon-cutout-basic
notes: Approved by Homi 9 Oct 2026 (T4). Transparent icons: Z-Image-Turbo 1024x1024 exactly as image-zimage-basic v1.0 (CLIPLoader lumina2, shift 3, 9 steps, cfg 1, res_multistep/simple), then the built-in cut-out chain proven in step 4 (RemoveBackground with BiRefNet, MIT -> InvertMask -> JoinImageWithAlpha). Two outputs: _raw.png (opaque, for Homi's check) and _cutout.png (RGBA, the deliverable; Stage 1 already requires transparency on *_cutout*). Prompt rule: ask for 'solid filled shapes, centered, empty space around, on a plain single-colour background, no frame, no border, no text' - a flat single-colour background cuts cleanly; busy backgrounds leave fringes. All four models Apache 2.0 / MIT -> commercial OK.
